Reasoning: Let the horizontal length of the inner white rectangle be L. The area of the inner rectangle is L×1=L. The outer rectangle dimensions of the light gray ring are (L+2)×3, so the area of the light gray region is 3(L+2)-L=2L+6. The outer rectangle dimensions of the dark gray ring are (L+4)×5, and the inner rectangle dimensions are (L+2)×3, so the area of the dark gray region is 5(L+4)-3(L+2)=2L+14. The areas of the three colored regions form an arithmetic sequence, so the adjacent differences are equal: (2L+6)-L=(2L+14)-(2L+6). Simplifying gives L+6=8, so L=2.
